criteria.requirement: The policy manifest and conformance schema agree with the normative text.
criteria.finding: The protected reconciliation binds all seven normative source parts, 119 substantive requirement rows and six normative-keyword bindings to machine representations and validators, with candidate machine-contract corrections explicitly separated from v1 promotion.

criteria.requirement: Each profile has an approved owner and review role map.
criteria.finding: P01-P07 each have a protected lifecycle-owner and G0-G9 review-role map projected from existing institutional authority. Steward owns profile lifecycle; artifact ownership remains mandatory per-artifact metadata; G8 remains promotion-only.

criteria.requirement: Mandatory fields have machine-readable definitions and validation tests.
criteria.finding: The protected coverage record derives mandatory fields and machine semantics from exact agreement-matrix rows, re-derives required field sets from live schemas, mutation-tests omissions, and tests exact-version, enum, format, ASSURED-review, gate/review revision and NOT_APPLICABLE semantics while preserving review-only rows as review-only.

criteria.requirement: The exception workflow has fail-closed tests.
criteria.finding: Protected adversarial tests fail closed on missing or unresolved approval authority, unauthorized approvers, missing review/expiry timing, attempted waiver of non-waivable requirements, insufficient compensating controls, malformed records/dates, and missing/expired/revoked/non-approved required exceptions.

criteria.requirement: Gate records bind to immutable artifact revisions.
criteria.finding: Gate and review records require reviewed_revision, gate/review pairs fail closed on revision mismatch, and ASSURED declarations require a review linked to source_revision. Real pilot records use immutable git-blob/git-commit identities.
criteria.gap: The machine contract still accepts any nonempty string for source_revision/reviewed_revision. It does not reject mutable symbolic references such as branch names or 'latest', and gate-review equality alone does not universally prove that the shared value is immutable or bound to the artifact declaration. Standard-wide immutability is therefore not established.

criteria.requirement: Candidate and authoritative source records are distinct in the schema.
criteria.finding: Protected pilot practice cleanly separates candidate communication supplements from authoritative subjects and the schema requires machine-readable authority_status.
criteria.gap: The conformance schema uses one record shape whose authority_status enum includes candidate, admitted and authoritative. It has no discriminated candidate-record versus authoritative-source-record schema forms, so the distinction is operationally represented but not structurally distinct in schema as the criterion requires.

criteria.requirement: Orphan detection covers documents, web pages, source records, candidate records, assets, static text, TeX, JSON, and directories where applicable.
criteria.finding: The protected control composes MkDocs/Documentary Library discovery with generic Markdown, HTML, static-text, TeX, JSON/YAML and governed-directory reference discovery; definite governed orphans, missing targets, repository escapes and governed identity hidden in scratch fail closed, while deliberately non-governed scratch remains outside registration.

criteria.requirement: At least one mathematical, experimental, software, operational, governance, and public artifact has completed a pilot conformance review.
criteria.finding: All six required real artifact classes have protected pilot review evidence. The five candidate supplements have completed internal G0-G7 pilot conformance reviews with PASS decisions on exact revisions; the historical operational GHOS documentary pilot has completed G0-G9 including independent G8 and protected G9. Promotion of the candidate supplements is not required by criterion 8 and remains deferred.

criteria.requirement: The pilots record false positives, false negatives, burden, and unresolved ambiguities.
criteria.finding: Protected measurements explicitly record false-positive evidence and limits, false-negative evidence and limits, burden proxies, unresolved ambiguities, defects, unknown empirical-rate caveats, P04 structural burden and zero incremental scientific compute.

criteria.requirement: The Referee approves promotion with an explicit statement of remaining limitations.
criteria.finding: Criterion 10 is not activated because criteria 1-9 are not all materially satisfied: criteria 5 and 6 remain PARTIAL.
criteria.gap: No Referee promotion disposition may be requested or manufactured until a fixed candidate revision satisfies criteria 1-9.
